note: Shared AXN position ledger. Consumed by /api/register-symbolon via compare-and-swap and honored by scripts/mint_deposit.py next_hex_id(). A position is an address, not a verification: witnessed-unverified entries hold real positions pending byte verification.
sequence_authority: max(registry hex, this ledger) — the two allocators share one space and can never collide
invariant: ONE KERNEL, ONE POSITION. The witness endpoint dedupes against both the symbolon entries and the main registry's kernel index before allocating; the deposit pipeline refuses to mint a kernel the witness layer already positioned. The stamp is authority-independent and can be made offline by anyone — uniqueness is enforced at the allocation gate, the only place it can be.
